3 فُلَانٌ يُوَامِئُ فُلَانًا , and يُوَائِمُ, [Such a one agrees, or vies, with such a one]. These two verbs are of two different dialects, or the former is formed by transposition from the latter. (K, TA.) ―
-b2- ISh quotes, “فَأَنَا الغذَاةَ مُوَامِئُهْ
” meaning, accord. to Abu-l-Khattáb, “ And I, in the morning, shall see him, or it: ” syn. مُعَايِنُهُ. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
